lang.name: English
site.name: AI Academy
site.tagline: A personal learning space for a software engineer.
site.description: Daily AI engineering lessons with exercises, from tokens to agents. Readable on desktop and phone, online or offline.
site.footer: Personal AI engineering course. Your notes and progress stay on this device unless you sign in to sync them.
home.intro: Short daily lessons with runnable exercises. Predict, run, compare, and keep your notes and progress in sync across devices.
home.continue.start.hint: No progress yet. Pick a course below, or start with the first lesson of AI Engineering.
home.continue.allDone: You have completed every published lesson. New lessons appear here as they are added.
home.review.hint: Questions you marked for review and lessons you bookmarked.
home.search.label: Search lessons and notes
home.search.none: Nothing matches. Try a shorter word.
home.planned.hint: Planned lessons are not written yet. They show the direction of the track.
home.track.empty: No lessons published yet in this track.
home.notes.hint: Short references that sit beside the lessons.
home.data.hint: Everything you type is saved on this device immediately. Sign in to keep it in sync across your devices.
lesson.label: Lesson {n}
lesson.regenerated: Regenerated lesson. The original text was not available, so this page was rebuilt from the course summary and progress tracker. It will be replaced if the original is recovered.
lesson.untranslated: This lesson has not been translated yet. You are reading the English version.
lesson.exercise.run: Run it from the project folder:
lesson.notes.hint: Write your predictions before you run the exercise, then your observations after. Saved as you type.
lesson.notes.placeholder: What do I expect to see, and why?
lesson.notes.nostorage: Browser storage is unavailable, so this text will not be kept.
lesson.quiz.hint: Answer in your head first, then reveal. Mark what you want to see again.
note.label: Concept note
offline.cached: Offline. This page is available from the local copy.
account.title: Settings and sync
account.notConfigured: Cloud sync is not configured on this site yet. Your progress and notes are saved on this device. See docs/SETUP_AND_DEPLOYMENT.md in the repository to enable it.
account.intro: Sign in with your email to keep progress, notes, bookmarks and preferences in sync across devices. No password: you receive a one-time link.
account.sent: Check your inbox. Open the link on this device to finish signing in.
account.signOut.hint: Signing out keeps a local copy on this device.
account.deleteCloud.confirm: Delete all your synced learning data from the cloud? This device keeps its local copy until you clear it.
account.imported: Imported {n} items. Newer entries won; notes that differed were merged.
account.importFailed: That file is not an AI Academy export.
account.clearLocal.confirm: Remove all progress, notes and preferences from this device?
account.loadFailed: The sync service could not be loaded. You can keep working; data stays on this device.
merge.title: Merge your progress?
merge.body: This device has learning data and your account already has data from elsewhere. Choose what to do. Nothing is deleted automatically.
merge.merge.hint: Keeps completed lessons from both, uses the newest version of each entry, and keeps both versions of notes that differ.
merge.cloud.hint: Replaces this device's data with what is in your account.
pwa.install: Add this site to your home screen for an app-like, offline experience.
home.courses.hint: Each course is a sequence of short lessons with exercises.
course.label: Course
settings.appearance.hint: System follows your device's light or dark setting.
